water_normal.generator: tools/blender/bake_water_normals.py (Blender 5.2.1 Ocean modifier, Phillips spectrum, resolution 32, spatial size 24 m, wind 7 m/s, minimum wave scale 0.1, alignment 0.35, seed 7, choppiness 0)
water_normal.method: One baked height frame converted to a tangent-space OpenGL (+Y) normal map with wrapped central differences, so the texture tiles. Desktop 1024px, mobile 512px box-downsampled from the same normals, WebP quality 92.

stills: Metal and glass desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (780x910) stills were recaptured on 2026-09-28 at dusk after the block polish, with sun elevations from -6.26 to -5.69 degrees. The login card and HTML slogan were hidden during capture. Reproduction: output/block-polish-20260928/capture-stills.js; the PNGs were encoded as WebP with ffmpeg libwebp quality 86. The selected material determines the fallback image.
brand_colors: Official ISU CI RGB palette from https://www.isu.co.kr/kor/prcenter/ci.jsp and its downloadable isu_ci_pdf.pdf: Blue #008FD4, Green #99CA3C, Gold #B4985A, Silver #A7A9AC, Light Gray #E5E4E0. The 3D logo and HTML slogans use the Blue and Green base values; scene lighting, translucency, hover highlights, and the darker button shade affect displayed pixels.

block_model.generator: tools/blender/build_isu_blocks.py, Blender 5.2.1, 26 blocks, 261792 triangles, bevel radius ratio 0.13, voxel size 0.024, smooth normals to 75 degrees, UV island margin 0.008, bake margin 4px, neutral normal fill outside islands. The embedded glTF material is a transport default; the login scene applies the selected metal or glass material at runtime.
block_model.roughness_maps: isu-blocks-roughness.webp and mobile/isu-blocks-roughness.webp derive from the green channel of the corresponding detail map with ffmpeg lutrgb value 200 + 0.2 * source, WebP quality 85.

water_scene: apps/web/app/login/isu-water-scene.ts selects a satin metal or frosted glass block material once per visit, then keeps it fixed. A 120-second continuous day cycle (isu-day-cycle.ts) moves the sun from behind the camera in the east, over the south, to the western horizon ahead. Single-scattering atmosphere and a small twilight fill (isu-atmosphere.ts, isu-sky.ts) derive the sky and lighting from the sun direction, while exposure follows fixed sun-elevation stops. Two small sky PMREMs blend over 0.8 seconds as the sun moves, preventing hard changes in the metal reflection. The water uses eight analytic dispersion waves, a static baked micro-normal, slow wind patches, a mipmapped Three.js reflection, physical Schlick reflectance, GGX sun glints, and limited horizon haze. Pointer motion feeds a small wave-equation simulation (isu-ripples.ts). Block hover uses a small lift, tilt, and material sheen without a point light. The three files in Downloads/참고이미지 were used for water, sun, and horizon visual guidance only; no pixels were copied into the app. The separate HTML slogan uses the local Geist font and an in-text pointer sheen.
